beIN STORY (Between the gloves)
programme.desc: The beIN SPORTS teams followed professional boxers Rima Ayadi, Dylan Charrat and Bilel Jkitou on their journey for a full year, to understand what led them to choose this discipline, so demanding and ruthless, and to measure the difficulty of being a boxer, while professional boxing in France is experiencing a deep crisis. Travel from France to Douala or even Los Angeles with the portraits of these boxers to discover the hardness of the training, the fights of each and the links which bind them to their trainers: Abadila Hallab, Éric Tormos, Fayçal Omrani and the legendary Freddie Roach

programme.title: Wild Cuba: A trip to the Caribbean | E01
programme.desc: Colin Stafford Johnson takes viewers back to a time just 50 years ago when Earth's wildlife seemed abundant. It is a journey into a world that may soon disappear forever. The expedition begins in the south of the island in the Zapata Swamp. The largest single protected area in the entire Caribbean is home to the world's smallest bird, the bee hummingbird. Decades of a conservation-minded socialist government, US embargoes and minimal development have left the region largely unchanged for five decades. Regardless of politics, Cuba's isolation has created a natural citadel in the Caribbean. Forests cover large areas of the island, and its waters contain some of the richest coral reefs in the world. Half of Cuba's flora and fauna are found only here - from the local species of crocodiles and snakes to the smallest birds and frogs on the planet. Colin Stafford Johnson begins his expedition in the swamps of the Zapata Peninsula. Cuba's isolation means that there are places that have remained unchanged for decades, and the coral reef is one of the richest in the world. Austria. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Greater Africa – Namib Desert | E02

programme.title: Greater Africa – Okawanago Delta | E03

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Two Bills
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

S1 «Super Senses: The Secret Power of Animals»…Our human senses are pretty incredible – but we only see, hear and smell a tiny fraction of what's out there. There is a hidden world that animals across the globe can experience. In this episode we explore the powerful world of scent and the animals that have pushed their sense of smell way beyond human abilities. In the Bahamas, Helen dives into shark-infested waters with only a small pouch of liquid as her defense. Patrick controls the behavior of a swarm of bees using tiny traces of scent, and gets uncomfortably close to one of the smelliest animals in the world – a skunk!Incredible three-part documentary series in which hosts, biologist Patrick Aryee and physicist Helen Czerski, explore the extraordinary world of animal senses, doing various experiments and demonstrations featuring a variety of species. programme.title: Arctic Secrets: Yukon Wild (S2 E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2017. S2, Ep2
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S2, Ep2 «Arctic Secrets»…The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich'in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call «Yu-kun- ah», or, the «great river». The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering SeaWith its vast expanses of pristine white snow and clear glacial waters the landscapes of the Arctic are truly stunning, But, don't be fooled, for those who must live in this demanding environment, it is far from a winter wonderland. This documentary series takes a look at the people and animals for whom the Arctic is home. We see how Inuit tribes, orcas, polar bears and more survive the challenges of living in the severe climate of the northernmost part of our planet. The tribes and species of the Arctic have spent thousands of years learning how to adapt to the change of the seasons. They must now adapt to a new threat; the impact of climate changeDirector: Allan Code

It's not just our closest relatives in the animal kingdom who play: "Terra X" shows that birds, reptiles and even fish also enjoy pointless pastime.

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Indonesia's spectacular underwater world: In the Blue Corner off Nusa Penida you will not only find huge corals, but also the legendary sunfish - the heaviest bony fish in the world. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Tropical forests meet warm seas in Triton Bay off New Guinea. Freshwater forms a rare ecosystem with impressive whale sharks and a rich variety of colored soft corals. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: Between the Pacific and the Indian Ocean: The poisonous, black-banded sea snake roams the coral reefs here. She only briefly comes to the surface to breathe. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: In the Lembeh Strait, mud and lava form an unusual biotope. Microorganisms are hidden inside - including the decorator crab with its pungent smell. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: Ken O'Sullivan begins his journey in the dark waters off the coast of Northern Ireland. From there, the underwater filmmaker delves into the hidden secrets of the North Atlantic. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: This journey takes the underwater filmmaker into the barely explored world of the North Atlantic. Ken O'Sullivan is the first to document the migration routes of fin whales along the south coast of Ireland. (Station info).

programme.title: Wild North Atlantic
programme.desc: Underwater filmmaker Ken O'Sullivan follows in the footsteps of early explorers. He encounters the most diverse and impressive sea creatures in the North Atlantic. (Station info).

programme.title: Alien Abyss – Extraterrestrial Depth
programme.desc: Glowing tentacles, huge octopuses, monster-like fish - our oceans are up to 11 km deep and their creatures are shrouded in myth. The New Zealander Job Rustenhoven (“Wonders of the Ocean”) not only appears on the doorstep in three Monday episodes.

programme.title: Alien Abyss – Extraterrestrial Depth
programme.desc: Life in the deep sea poses enormous challenges for the animal world. To survive in this extreme environment, many sea creatures form unusual alliances. (Station info).

programme.title: Alien Abyss – Extraterrestrial Depth
programme.desc: It's mating season in the deep sea. While some bizarre sea creatures engage in bloody courtship battles, others already have their fins full with their offspring. (Station info).

programme.title: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: A competition of giants: experts use spectacular jumping and strength challenges to test whether male or female great white sharks are the true rulers of the ocean. (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: Baby Boom in the Delta: The team observes a lioness protecting her cubs in the midst of danger, while a cheetah fights for the survival of her cubs. The leopard also has offspring. (Station info).

programme.title: Großkatzen 24/7
programme.desc: On the edge of chaos, the lion pride struggles with hunger and rivalry. At the same time, a single cheetah defies the overwhelming army of lions. (Station info).

programme.title: Underdogs in the animal kingdom
programme.desc: Extraordinary creatures adapt to their habitat using amazing strategies. Whether flightless birds or carnivorous plants, nature produces bizarre survival artists who go their own way. (Station info).

programme.title: Hugely big and tiny
programme.desc: In this documentary, hummingbirds flutter in front of the lens as representatives of the tiny creatures, while ostriches represent the giants. Male ostriches can grow up to 2.75 meters tall, but they cannot fly. \n\nExciting journey through the world's flora and fauna!

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: They defy heat, cold and danger: rodents that have adapted perfectly to their environment. A tribute to the often underestimated and clever animals. (Station info).

programme.title: Heroes of evolution
programme.desc: Pelicans, herons, storks and albatrosses: some of the most impressive representatives of this group. How do these birds cope with the changes in their environment? (Station info).

programme.title: Oases of biodiversity
programme.desc: The island groups of the Caribbean are home to intact ecosystems that inspire scientists. Because of its isolated location, the Greater Antilles are home to an infinite number of animal species. (Station info).

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. programme.title: LONG TỘC TRỪ MA: MÃ TIỂU LINH - MY DATE WITH A VAMPIRE
programme.desc: Thợ săn quỷ Ma Siu Ling giải quyết những bí ẩn siêu nhiên và chiến đấu với linh hồn ma quỷ. Trong quá trình điều tra, cô tình cờ gặp thám tử bí ẩn Fong, người có quá khứ bị che giấu gắn liền với một số phận đen tối.
